name: fill-bits-and-extra-octets-ignored
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): Input: the message of vector 02 with its 0 fill bits set to 1 and two octets ffff after it. Decode reads the lines from bit 0 and ignores the rest (The whole message; ruling 9 of 0.8); encode writes zero fill bits. 120 bits, padded with 0 zero bits to 15 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
